about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: WS-VARIABLES' first byte is WS-PGMNAME, which the port keeps as a typed Java field (initialState sets it to 'COADM01C'); the image byte is never read

a CLRP key no longer sets EIBAID, which keeps its initial byte (DFHEIBLK's image: a space); COADM01C tests EIBAID only against DFHENTER and DFHPF3, so a space takes WHEN OTHER exactly as CLRP does
an OPID key no longer sets EIBAID, which keeps its initial byte (a space); COADM01C tests EIBAID only against DFHENTER and DFHPF3, so a space takes WHEN OTHER exactly as OPID does
a PF4 key no longer sets EIBAID, which keeps its initial byte (a space); COADM01C tests EIBAID only against DFHENTER and DFHPF3, so a space takes WHEN OTHER exactly as PF4 does
Goback's constructor without super(null, null, false, false): the default constructor only also records a stack trace; nothing reads the exception but its type

the scan over outer PERFORMs iterates only when a paragraph that is not its range's last returns inside a nested PERFORM; COADM01C's PERFORMs each name one paragraph (from == thru), MAIN-PARA (runTask's 0-7) always ends in RETURN / XCTL, and the GO TO into PGMIDERR-ERR-PARA ends in its RETURN, so the scan never iterates
MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE at MAIN-PARA's start: every task starts from initialState, where WS-MESSAGE is already spaces (WS-VARIABLES' image), and nothing writes it before this statement
inside `if (0 != 0)`: SEND MAP has no RESP and the translator writes its response as the constant 0, so the block never runs

EVALUATE WS-IDX's WHEN 7 is tested only when WS-IDX is not 1-6, and BUILD-MENU-OPTIONS' loop runs WS-IDX 1 to CDEMO-ADMIN-OPT-COUNT, the constant 6 (infeasible_outcomes.json, carddemo-adminmenu 241:WHEN@254)
